senses.gloss:
1. नु नु, and नू नू, ved. (perhaps akin to नव, cf. नूतन), a particle,
 1. Now (ved.).
 2. A particle of interrogation in two or more interrogative sentences succeeding each other, Śāk. d. 137.
 3. Preceded by interrogatives, MBh. 5, 6003.
 4. नु--नु, Either... or, Rām. 2, 72, 27; नु--नु--नु ... or...or, Kir. 5, 1.
 5. A part. of affirmation, Indeed, Chr. 291, 13 = Rigv. i. 64, 13.
 --Cf. νύ; Goth. nu; A.S. nu; νῦν; Lat. nunc (i. e. num-ce = νῦν κεν); Goth. nuh.

2. नु नु, ii. 2, and नु, or नू नू, i. 6, नुव, Par., and ved. i. 1, Ātm.
 1. To shout (ved.).
 2. To praise, Bhāg. P. 3, 23, 39.
 --With the prep. परि परि, णु णु, To praise, 1, 8, 44.
 --With प्र प्र, णु णु, To praise, 3, 21, 22.
